messages.subject: geom_path question
parts:
Hello again

From the examples for geom_path

I run

myear <- do.call(rbind, by(movies, movies$year, function(df) data.frame(year=df$year[1], mean.length = mean(df$length), mean.rating=mean(df$rating))))
p <- ggplot(myear, aes(x=mean.length, y=mean.rating))
p + geom_path()

# Add aesthetic mappings
p + geom_path(aes(size=year))

but, in the resulting plot, the line width is constant

If I run the next line

p + geom_path(aes(colour=year))

the color does vary, but several of the colors are almost invisible, and the ones that are visible are nearly impossible to distinguish from each other.


Help, please?

Peter
